notes.title: 01/08/2019 - Version 1.6 patch notes
notes.notes:
Hello, it's been a long time since our last update of the game. We've been working hard to bring you new features, visual changes, new languages and performance fixes.
The following extensive list explains in detail all the changes of this version:



ALL PLATFORMS

 New main menu interface. The new menu is more intuitive and explains clearly what each section contains.
 New pause menu interface. Now it is easier to know your current stats during a challenge while the game is paused.
 Base code has been rewritten and reviewed. What does this mean? We have performed a rather complicated surgery and reviewed all the code from scratch which guarantees that the game will now run smoother in all platforms and there will be a lower chance of errors.
 New saving system encryption. We have improved our security layers of the saving system. Now, you won't be able to grant yourself infinite screws so easily :)
 Added a greeting message the first time you execute the game.
 The game is available in French... Oh là là.
 Added a new game mode in the single player: Time trial. Try to complete all the 80 levels of the game before the time runs out. Will you manage to complete all the challenges?
 Added the medals. Depending on how much time you take to complete a challenge, you will be granted a gold, silver or bronze medal (or if you are really bad at this game, you won't be given any medal).
 Final game file size has been compressed even further. Old assets which are no longer needed by the new interfaces have been deleted.
 Are you stuck in a level? We have added the possibility to skip a level. Pause the current level you are playing, search the 'Skip level' button, and if you have enough screws, you will be able to use it.
 Added new achievements to the game.


WINDOWS

 Updated Steamworks SDK to the latest version.
 Fixed an error with newer versions of Windows 10 which didn't properly synchronize the game speed.


LINUX

 Updated Steamworks SDK to the latest version.
 Fixed a saving error because a specific folder returned an error in newer Linux versions.
 Fixed an error where the FPS were uncapped when running with an NVIDIA graphics card.


ANDROID

 Updated Google Play services SDK.
 Added support for Android API 29.
 Added cloud save.
 Added Google Play services full support (now you will be able to get achievements and view leaderboards like in all other platforms where the game is being distributed).
 Improved the virtual keyboard. It will be easier to control the character while playing.
 Added adaptive icons support for newer Android devices.



We are sure you will love all the changes we made to the game to make it even better.
Have lots of fun playing 'I was rebuilt' this summer! :)


The 'Gurila Ware Games' team

notes.title: 15/10/18 Update to version 1.3
notes.notes:
Hello, here you have all the release notes for this update:

ALL PLATFORMS

    Some performance issues were corrected, now the game should run better.
    Fixed an issue that made textures be flushed from memory at the change of level and also at the begining of a level, now they are only flushed at the change of a level, this will decrease slightly the loading times.
    Added more levels up until chapter 8 level 8.
    Fixed an issue with the gravity change, now the player will stick properly to the upper walls and not with 1 pixel clipping through it.

WINDOWS

    No changes for only Windows platform.

LINUX

    Fixed Linux cloud storage for Steam.

ANDROID

    Max API level is now 28.
    Minimun API level is now 16.
    Fixed an issue with the virtual keyboard beeing not properly scaled on modern devices, now it should work perfectly.
   Fixed an issue with Google Play connection which could cause a memory leak if two or more achievements were granted at the same time.


Have fun playing the new update of I was rebuilt.

notes.title: I May Die! - Update 24/01/2018
notes.notes:
Hi there!
It is time for another update, we are getting close to finish the story mode of the game, but there is still work to do, in this update we bring you new levels for you to play:

Version 4.1.2 - The "Back from christmas" update
Graphics:

Art for the new objects and hazards has been added.
Scaling has been improved for small dimensioned screens.

Gameplay:

You can now play up to level 9 of chapter 7.
New hazards added.
There is also an object added that will give you the ability to attack to some enemies like the eyes that made your life miserable up until chapter 7.

Miscellaneous:

Fixed a physics issue which consumed more resources than needed. Now the game consumes less resources.


Have fun playing the new levels of I may die!

notes.title: I May Die! - 3rd Big update 05/12/2017
notes.notes:
Hello!
After a while programming and designing new stuff, we bring you today a 3rd huge update which include lots of changes. For more information read the patch notes below:

Version 4.1 - The "World expanding" update
Graphics:

No significant changes in graphics.

Gameplay:

Boss of chapter 5, Wyrmulon, is now playable.
Chapter 6 is now open, horray!
9 levels are now playable in chapter 6.
Moving platforms have been added.
Switch moving platforms have been added.
Color changing platforms have been added.
Gravitron has been added, it is time to mess with the gravity.
The thunderbolt terminals have been leveled to be more fair, time between attacks has been increased.
Acid guns have been also leveled to be more fair, time between attacks has been increased. Also the duration of the acid in the world has been reduced.

Miscellaneous:

A bug which made the music stop after restarting a level has been fixed.
A bug which did not display the mid jump sprite of a character in some cases has been fixed.
An error with the lasers which created a big data structure producing a memory leak in some cases has been fixed.
Performance changes have been made, now the game should run smoother.
An error that did not update the money value after buying has been fixed.


Apart from all the changes listed, we have started working in the possibility of adding the Steam Inventory so you can acquire objects. You can start acquiring them and trading them, but they won't be functional until future updates.

Also we have changed the music in all levels, these new musics have been made by our new composer Jonathan Hall Couto.

Have fun playing the new levels of I may die!
